decisions.reason: After two years with only brief website mentions and no visible commitment, weak results are no longer seen as temporary, so the firm drops the product.
Its own page and documented field application signal public commitment and sunk costs, making withdrawal hard to justify.
A multi-model product line indicates substantial investment and established components, so escalation leads the firm to persist.
Its own page represents visible public commitment, so dropping it would expose earlier decisions as mistakes.
Although commitment is low, its recent launch lets management attribute weak results to temporary causes, so it is kept.
